verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail publishes several per-item fees: $20 per check deposit, $5 per international shipment and $10 per expedited shipment plus postage, and $15 per expedited scan. It also states storage terms (unlimited digital, 30 days for letters and 10 days for packages) and that scanning is free up to the plan limit. However, the evidence shows no monthly plan price, no numeric scan allowance, and no standard overage scan or extended storage fee. Missing for 10: monthly plan prices, specific scan allowances per plan, standard per-scan overage fee, domestic standard forwarding fee, physical storage overage fee.
